content_text: All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file. The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning. Unreleased¶ Release highlights¶ Breaking changes¶ Deprecations¶ New features¶ Fixed bugs¶ 0.44.0 - 2026-08-05¶ Release highlights¶ Support for fetching and pushing tags has now been stabilized. Tags can be tracked or untracked just like bookmarks. Tracked tags are pushed by default. Breaking changes¶ jj git fetch now fetches tags the same way it fetches bookmarks. Tags are fetched as <name>@<remote>, and these remote tags are automatically tracked by local tags of the same name. Running jj git fetch in an existing repository will re-fetch all tags to initialize the tracking state. Git's tagOpt is no longer respected. To disable tag fetching, set remotes.<name>.fetch-tags = '~*' in the jj configuration. jj git clone --fetch-tags=all|none|included is removed in favor of --tag=PATTERN. jj git push --all now pushes all tags in addition to bookmarks. The WorkspaceRef.root() and RepoPath.absolute() template functions now return Option<FsPath> and FsPath respectively, instead of String. The path keyword in jj config list templates now returns Option<FsPath>. jj file search now prints every matched line prefixed by the file path, instead of only the file paths of files containing a match. Use --name-only for the previous behavior. #9399 Passing an argument more than once is no longer an error. The last occurrence wins, so jj --no-pager --no-pager version and jj log -n 5 -n 10 now work, and an argument baked into an alias or a wrapper can be given explicitly as well. Arguments that can be specified multiple times, such as --config and jj log -r, are unaffected and still collect all of their values. #8101 #9859 Deprecations¶ None New features¶ New merge_point() revset function which (similar to fork_point) finds the point where multiple branches merge. jj workspace list now shows workspace roots by default. The output can be customized with templates.workspace_list or -T, and WorkspaceRef.root() returns an optional FsPath value. #9713, #9826 New try(expr, fallback...) template function to suppress runtime errors. jj run now processes revisions from oldest to newest by default. The start order is guaranteed: each revision begins execution only after the previous one has started, even with --jobs higher than 1. jj run gained a --passthrough flag that connects the subprocess's stdout/stderr directly to the terminal instead of capturing output. jj run gained a --ignore-changes flag to avoid editing any revisions even if the command modifies the working copy. jj run gained a --ignore-errors flag to continue running against the remaining revisions even if the command exits with a nonzero exit code. jj file search now supports -n/--line-number to prefix each match with its 1-based line number within the file. jj git push gained a --allow-conflicts flag to allow pushing commits containing conflicts. New jj tag track/untrack commands to associate local tags with remotes. Note that fetched tags are tracked by default. Added builtin_log() revset alias for the built-in default jj log revset. revsets.log now defaults to builtin_log(), so custom log revsets can reuse the built-in default instead of copying its full expression. Added config option diff.stat.max-bar-width for use with --stat to limit the ++-- bar width. In the templating language, diff.stat() can optionally take a second (positional or named) argument max_bar_width for an equivalent effect. jj absorb now supports --interactive/-i/--tool to let you interactively choose which hunks from the source to consider for absorption. This is useful when you only want to absorb part of a commit without first splitting it. Any hunks that are not selected or cannot be absorbed remain in the source commit. Fixed bugs¶ Recursive alias definitions are detected more precisely. jj can now expand aliases that are simply repeated. For example, with the alias jj = [], the command jj jj jj will resolve to jj. Aliases can also fall back to the default command. For example, with the alias i = ["--ignore-working-copy"], jj i will resolve to jj --ignore-working-copy. Git temporary files are now cleaned up more reliably in the presence of signals (e.g. Ctrl-C). This should reduce the rate of "Could not acquire lock for index file" errors. (#7530) Fixed Git HEAD mismatch after the working copy became immutable. #9827 jj now creates a new working-copy revision as soon as the one of the current workspace becomes immutable, as well as during snapshotting. This brings the behavior closer to jj 0.42 and earlier. Snapshotting no longer fails if the working copy contains a path whose name isn't valid UTF-8. Such paths can't be tracked, so they are now skipped and reported as a warning instead. #9774 Fixed failure when reading configuration in copied repo with an empty repo-level configuration directory. jj diff and jj status no longer omit a rename or copy in a merge commit when the renamed source is present in more than one parent. The identical copy record reported for each parent was mistaken for a conflict and discarded. #9752 jj run no longer panics when its revset includes a conflicted commit. The conflict is now preserved in the rewritten commit. #9747 Fixed a panic when passing overly-large length parameters to ID templater functions (commit_id.short(), commit_id.shortest(), etc.). #9833 jj git import and export in colocated workspaces are now disabled by default. These commands usually do nothing, but they had a race condition. Contributors¶ Thanks to the people who made this release happen! Breaking changes¶ The deprecated git_head() and git_refs() functions have been removed from revsets and templates. Git-like symbols (e.g. refs/heads/main) are no longer resolved to revisions. Use the bookmark/tag <name> or <name>@<remote> syntax instead. The deprecated ui.revsets-use-glob-by-default option has been removed. jj bookmark track/untrack no longer supports <kind>:<bookmark>@<remote> patterns. However, the <bookmark>@<remote> symbol syntax is still supported. #9226 Deprecations¶ New features¶ jj show now supports --reversed flag. jj now looks for config files in /etc/jj. jj config gc will delete configuration of deleted/moved repos from ~/.config/jj/repos folder. #9362 jj run allows you to run a command over a set of changes, each with their own private working copy; the commands may update the working copy and changes/conflicts are propagated accordingly, e.g., jj run -- cargo check --all-features or jj run -- cargo fix behaves as one might expect. jj gerrit upload now supports the -o (--option) flag, which works like git push -o (--push-option). jj git fetch now rebases the descendants of revisions that were rewritten based on their change IDs. Previously, when multiple bookmarked revisions existed in a stack, those rewritten revisions and their descendants wouldn't always be rebased. Note that immutable descendants will not be rebased. Add a forks() revset function that yields all commits with more than 1 child. colors config now supports crossed-out text styling with { crossed-out = true }. Fixed bugs¶ On Windows, querying a path's file identity no longer follows symbolic links, matching the behavior on Unix. Previously a symlink shared the identity of its target, so two symlinks pointing at the same target were treated as the same file. This identity check is used when writing the working copy to detect aliases of the reserved .git and .jj directories. #8924 jj now creates a new working-copy revision during snapshotting if the working copy was immutable. Previously, the new revision was created immediately after the working copy became immutable. #7751 #9338 jj git remote add now warns if the new remote exactly matches an existing remote's fetch URL or effective push URL. #413 Fixed corrupt loose Git objects on Intel Raptor Lake CPU and aarch64. Invalid ui.graph.style configuration is now an error. The builtin template branch_list has been renamed to bookmark_list as part of the jj branch deprecation. Deprecations¶ jj branch has been deprecated in favor of jj bookmark. Rationale: Jujutsu's branches don't behave like Git branches, which a confused many newcomers, as they expected a similar behavior given the name. We've renamed them to "bookmarks" to match the actual behavior, as we think that describes them better, and they also behave similar to Mercurial's bookmarks. jj obslog is now called jj evolution-log/jj evolog. jj obslog remains as an alias. jj unsquash has been deprecated in favor of jj squash and jj diffedit --restore-descendants. Rationale: jj squash can be used in interactive mode to pull changes from one commit to another, including from a parent commit to a child commit. For fine-grained dependent diffs, such as when the parent and the child commits must successively modify the same location in a file, jj diffedit --restore-descendants can be used to set the parent commit to the desired content without altering the content of the child commit. The git.push-branch-prefix config has been deprecated in favor of git.push-bookmark-prefix. conflict() and file() revsets have been renamed to conflicts() and files() respectively. The old names are still around and will be removed in a future release. New features¶ The new config option snapshot.auto-track lets you automatically track only the specified paths (all paths by default). Use the new jj file track command to manually tracks path that were not automatically tracked. There is no way to list untracked files yet. Use git status in a colocated workspace as a workaround. #323 jj fix now allows fixing unchanged files with the --include-unchanged-files flag. This can be used to more easily introduce automatic formatting changes in a new commit separate from other changes. jj workspace add now accepts a --sparse-patterns=<MODE> option, which allows control of the sparse patterns for a newly created workspace: copy (inherit from parent; default), full (full working copy), or empty (the empty working copy). New command jj workspace rename that can rename the current workspace. jj op log gained an option to include operation diffs. jj git clone now accepts a --remote <REMOTE NAME> option, which allows to set a name for the remote instead of using the default origin. jj op undo now reports information on the operation that has been undone. jj squash: the -k flag can be used as a shorthand for --keep-emptied. CommitId / ChangeId template types now support .normal_hex(). jj commit and jj describe now accept --author option allowing to quickly change author of given commit. jj diffedit, jj abandon, and jj restore now accept a --restore-descendants flag. When used, descendants of the edited or deleted commits will keep their original content. jj git fetch -b <remote-git-branch-name> will now warn if the branch(es) can not be found in any of the specified/configured remotes. jj split now lets the user select all changes in interactive mode. This may be used to keeping all changes into the first commit while keeping the current commit description for the second commit (the newly created empty one). Author and committer names are now yellow by default. Fixed bugs¶ Update working copy before reporting changes. This prevents errors during reporting from leaving the working copy in a stale state. Rationale: jj checkout and jj merge both implement identical functionality, which is a subset of jj new. checkout creates a new working copy commit on top of a single specified revision, i.e. with one parent. merge creates a new working copy commit on top of at least two specified revisions, i.e. with two or more parents. The only difference between these commands and jj new, which also creates a new working copy commit, is that new can create a working copy commit on top of any arbitrary number of revisions, so it can handle both the previous cases at once. The only actual difference between these three commands is the command syntax and their name. These names were chosen to be familiar to users of other version control systems, but we instead encourage all users to adopt jj new instead; it is more general and easier to remember than both of these. jj checkout and jj merge will no longer be shown as part of jj help, but will still function for now, emitting a warning about their deprecation. Deadline: jj checkout and jj merge will be deleted and are expected become a hard error later in 2024. jj init --git and jj init --git-repo are now deprecated and will be removed in the near future. Use jj git init instead. Breaking changes¶ (Minor) Diff summaries (e.g. jj diff -s) now use D for "Deleted" instead of R for "Removed". @joyously pointed out that R could also mean "Renamed". jj util completion now takes the shell as a positional argument, not a flag. the previous behavior is deprecated, but supported for now. it will be removed in the future. jj rebase now preserves the shape of history even for merge commits where one parent is an ancestor of another. You can follow the jj rebase by jj rebase -s <merge commit> -d <single parent> if you want to linearize the history. New features¶ jj util completion now supports powershell and elvish. Official binaries for macOS running on Apple Silicon (aarch64-apple-darwin) are now available, alongside the existing macOS x86 binaries. New jj op abandon command is added to clean up the operation history. Git refs and commit objects can be further compacted by jj util gc. jj util gc now removes unreachable operation, view, and Git objects. jj branch rename will now warn if the renamed branch has a remote branch, since those will have to be manually renamed outside of jj. jj git push gained a --tracked option, to push all the tracked branches. There's now a virtual root operation, similar to the virtual root commit. It appears at the end of jj op log. jj config list gained a --include-overridden option to allow printing overridden config values. jj config list now accepts --user or --repo option to specify config origin. New jj config path command to print the config file path without launching an editor. jj tag list command prints imported git tags. jj next and jj prev now prompt in the event of the next/previous commit being ambiguous, instead of failing outright. jj resolve now displays the file being resolved. jj workspace root was aliased to jj root, for ease of discoverability jj diff no longer shows the contents of binary files. jj git now has an init command that initializes a git backed repo. Commits written by a new jj binary will not be read correctly by older jj binaries. The new model solves some performance problems with the old model. For example, jj log should be noticeably faster on large repos. You may need to create a new clone to see the full speedup. The remote_branches() revset now includes branches exported to the Git repository (so called Git-tracking branches.) This change will be reverted in 0.12.0. Status messages are now printed to stderr. jj config set now interprets the value as TOML also if it's a valid TOML array or table. Existing remote branches are migrated as follows: If local branch exists, the corresponding remote branches are considered tracking branches. Otherwise, the remote branches are non-tracking branches. If the deduced tracking flags are wrong, use jj branch track/untrack commands to fix them up. Non-tracking remote branches aren't listed by default. Use jj branch list --all to show all local and remote branches. It's not allowed to push branches if non-tracking remote branches of the same name exist. Pushing deleted/moved branches no longer abandons the local commits referenced by the remote branches. jj git fetch --branch now requires glob: prefix to expand * in branch name. New features¶ jj's stable release can now be installed with cargo binstall jj-cli. jj workspace add now takes a --revision argument. jj workspace forget can now forget multiple workspaces at once. branches()/remote_branches()/author()/committer()/description() revsets now support glob matching. jj branch delete/forget/list, and jj git push --branch now support string pattern syntax. The --glob option is deprecated in favor of glob: pattern. The branches/tags/git_refs/git_head template keywords now return a list of RefNames. They were previously pre-formatted strings. The new template keywords local_branches/remote_branches are added to show only local/remote branches. jj workspace add now preserves all parents of the old working-copy commit instead of just the first one. jj rebase -r gained the ability to rebase a revision A onto a descendant of A. Fixed bugs¶ Updating the working copy to a commit where a file that's currently ignored in the working copy no longer leads to a crash (#976). Conflicts in executable files can now be resolved just like conflicts in non-executable files (#1279). jj new --insert-before and --insert-after now respect immutable revisions (#2468). The --allow-large-revsets flag for jj rebase and jj new can no longer be used for allowing duplicate destinations. The author/committer template keywords and methods also return empty strings. Older binaries may not warn user when attempting to git push commits with such signatures. In revsets, the working-copy or remote symbols (such as @, workspace_id@, and branch@remote) can no longer be quoted as a unit. If a workspace or branch name contains whitespace, quote the name like "branch name"@remote. Also, these symbols will not be resolved as revset aliases or function parameters. For example, author(foo@) is now an error, and the revset alias 'revset-aliases.foo@' = '@' will be failed to parse. The root revset symbol has been converted to function root(). The ..x revset is now evaluated to root()..x, which means the root commit is no longer included. jj git push will now push all branches in the range remote_branches()..@ instead of only branches pointing to @ or @-. This is to clarify the distinction between change IDs and commit IDs, and to allow more efficient lookup of unique prefixes. This change doesn't affect the storage format; existing repositories will remain usable. New features¶ The default log format now uses the committer timestamp instead of the author timestamp. jj log --summary --patch now shows both summary and diff outputs. jj git push now accepts multiple --branch/--change arguments jj config list command prints values from config and config edit opens the config in an editor. jj debug config-schema command prints out JSON schema for the jj TOML config file format. jj resolve --list can now describe the complexity of conflicts. jj resolve now notifies the user of remaining conflicts, if any, on success. This can be prevented by the new --quiet option. Per-repository configuration is now read from .jj/repo/config.toml. Background colors, bold text, and underlining are now supported. The empty condition in templates is true when the commit makes no change to the three compared to its parents. branches([needle]) revset function now takes needle as an optional argument and matches just the branches whose name contains needle. remote_branches([branch_needle[, remote_needle]]) now takes branch_needle and remote_needle as optional arguments and matches just the branches whose name contains branch_needle and remote contains remote_needle. jj git fetch accepts repeated --remote arguments. For example, the entire tree of descendants of abc can be duplicated with jj duplicate abc:. jj log now highlights the shortest unique prefix of every commit and change id and shows the rest in gray. In content that goes to the terminal, the ANSI escape byte (0x1b) is replaced by a "␛" character. Fixed bugs¶ When sharing the working copy with a Git repo, we used to forget to export branches to Git when only the working copy had changed. That's now fixed. Commit description set by -m/--message is now terminated with a newline character, just like descriptions set by editor are. The -R/--repository path must be a valid workspace directory. Its ancestor directories are no longer searched. Fixed a crash when trying to access a commit that's never been imported into the jj repo from a Git repo. They will now be considered as non-existent if referenced explicitly instead of crashing. Fixed handling of escaped characters in .gitignore (only keep trailing spaces if escaped properly). jj undo now works after jj duplicate. jj duplicate followed by jj rebase of a tree containing both the original and duplicate commit no longer crashes. The fix should also resolve any remaining instances of https://github.com/jj-vcs/jj/issues/27. Fix the output of jj debug completion --help by reversing fish and zsh text. Fixed edge case in jj git fetch when a pruned branch is a prefix of another branch. Contributors¶ Thanks to the people who made this release happen! Aleksandr Mikhailov (@AM5800) Augie Fackler (@durin42) Benjamin Saunders (@Ralith) Daniel Ploch (@torquestomp) Danny Hooper (@hooper) David Barnett (@dbarnett) Glen Choo (@chooglen) Herby Gillot (@herbygillot) Ilya Grigoriev (@ilyagr) Luke Granger-Brown (@lukegb) Martin von Zweigbergk (@martinvonz) Michael Forster (@MForster) Philip Metzger (@PhilipMetzger) Ruben Slabbert (@rslabbert) Samuel Tardieu (@samueltardieu) Tal Pressman (@talpr) Vamsi Avula (@avamsi) Waleed Khan (@arxanas) Yuya Nishihara (@yuja) 0.6.1 - 2022-12-05¶ No changes, only changed to a released version of the thrift crate dependency. 0.6.0 - 2022-12-05¶ Breaking changes¶ Dropped candidates set argument from description(needle), author(needle), committer(needle), merges() revsets. Use x & description(needle) instead. Adjusted precedence of revset union/intersection/difference operators. x | y & z is now equivalent to x | (y & z). Support for open commits has been dropped. The ui.enable-open-commits config that was added in 0.5.0 is no longer respected. The jj open/close commands have been deleted. jj commit is now a separate command from jj close (which no longer exists). The behavior has changed slightly. It now always asks for a description, even if there already was a description set. It now also only works on the working-copy commit (there's no -r argument). If a workspace's working-copy commit has been updated from another workspace, most commands in that workspace will now fail. Use the new jj workspace update-stale command to update the workspace to the new working-copy commit. (The old behavior was to automatically update the workspace.) New features¶ Commands with long output are paginated. #9 The new jj git remote rename command allows git remotes to be renamed in-place. The new jj resolve command allows resolving simple conflicts with an external 3-way-merge tool. jj git push will search @- for branches to push if @ has none. The new revset function file(pattern..) finds commits modifying the paths specified by the pattern... The new revset function empty() finds commits modifying no files. Added support for revset aliases. New symbols and functions can be configured by revset-aliases.<name> = <expression>. It is now possible to specify configuration options on the command line with the new --config-toml global option. jj git subcommands will prompt for credentials when required for HTTPS remotes rather than failing. #469 Branches that have a different target on some remote than they do locally are now indicated by an asterisk suffix (e.g. main*) in jj log. #254 The commit ID was moved from first on the line in jj log output to close to the end. The goal is to encourage users to use the change ID instead, since that is generally more convenient, and it reduces the risk of creating divergent commits. The username and hostname that appear in the operation log are now configurable via config options operation.username and operation.hostname. jj git subcommands now support credential helpers. jj log will warn if it appears that the provided path was meant to be a revset. The new global flag -v/--verbose will turn on debug logging to give some additional insight into what is happening behind the scenes. Note: This is not comprehensively supported by all operations yet. jj log, jj show, and jj obslog now all support showing relative timestamps by setting ui.relative-timestamps = true in the config file. Fixed bugs¶ A bug in the export of branches to Git caused spurious conflicted branches. This typically occurred when running in a working copy colocated with Git (created by running jj init --git-dir=.). #463 When exporting branches to Git, we used to fail if some branches could not be exported (e.g. because Git doesn't allow a branch called main and another branch called main/sub). We now print a warning about these branches instead. #493 If you had modified branches in jj and also modified branches in conflicting ways in Git, jj git export used to overwrite the changes you made in Git. We now print a warning about these branches instead. jj edit root now fails gracefully. jj git import used to abandon a commit if Git branches and tags referring to it were removed. We now keep it if a detached HEAD refers to it. jj git import no longer crashes when all Git refs are removed. Git submodules are now ignored completely. Earlier, files present in the submodule directory in the working copy would become added (tracked), and later removed if you checked out another commit. You can now use git to populate the submodule directory and jj will leave it alone. Git's GC could remove commits that were referenced from jj in some cases. We are now better at adding Git refs to prevent that. #815 When the working-copy commit was a merge, jj status would list only the first parent, and the diff summary would be against that parent. The output now lists all parents and the diff summary is against the auto-merged parents. Contributors¶ Thanks to the people who made this release happen! Martin von Zweigbergk (@martinvonz) Benjamin Saunders (@Ralith) Yuya Nishihara (@yuja) Glen Choo (@chooglen) Ilya Grigoriev (@ilyagr) Ruben Slabbert (@rslabbert) Waleed Khan (@arxanas) Sean E. Russell (@xxxserxxx) Pranay Sashank (@pranaysashank) Luke Granger-Brown (@lukegb) 0.5.1 - 2022-10-17¶ No changes (just trying to get automated GitHub release to work). 0.5.0 - 2022-10-17¶ Breaking changes¶ Open commits are now disabled by default. That means that jj checkout will always create a new change on top of the specified commit and will let you edit that in the working copy. Set ui.enable-open-commits = true to restore the old behavior and let us know that you did so we know how many people prefer the workflow with open commits. jj [op] undo and jj op restore used to take the operation to undo or restore to as an argument to -o/--operation. It is now a positional argument instead (i.e. jj undo -o abc123 is now written jj undo abc123). An alias that is not configured as a string list (e.g. my-status = "status" instead of my-status = ["status"]) is now an error instead of a warning. jj log now defaults to showing only commits that are not on any remote branches (plus their closest commit on the remote branch for context). This set of commits can be overridden by setting ui.default-revset. Use jj log -r 'all()' for the old behavior. Read more about revsets here. #250 jj new now always checks out the new commit (used to be only if the parent was @). jj merge now checks out the new commit. The command now behaves exactly like jj new, except that it requires at least two arguments. When the working-copy commit is abandoned by jj abandon and the parent commit is open, a new working-copy commit will be created on top (the open parent commit used to get checked out). jj branch now uses subcommands like jj branch create and jj branch forget instead of options like jj branch --forget. #330 The $NO_COLOR environment variable no longer overrides the ui.color configuration if explicitly set. jj edit has been renamed to jj touchup, and jj edit is now a new command with different behavior. The new jj edit lets you edit a commit in the working copy, even if the specified commit is closed. jj git push no longer aborts if you attempt to push an open commit (but it now aborts if a commit does not have a description). jj git push now pushes only branches pointing to the @ by default. Use --all to push all branches. The checkouts template keyword is now called working_copies, and current_checkout is called current_working_copy. New features¶ The new jj interdiff command compares the changes in commits, ignoring changes from intervening commits. jj rebase now accepts a --branch/-b <revision> argument, which can be used instead of -r or -s to specify which commits to rebase. It will rebase the whole branch, relative to the destination. The default mode has changed from -r @ to -b @. The new jj print command prints the contents of a file in a revision. The new jj git remotes list command lists the configured remotes and their URLs. #243 jj move and jj squash now lets you limit the set of changes to move by specifying paths on the command line (in addition to the --interactive mode). For example, use jj move --to @-- foo to move the changes to file (or directory) foo in the working copy to the grandparent commit. When jj move/squash/unsquash abandons the source commit because it became empty and both the source and the destination commits have non-empty descriptions, it now asks for a combined description. If either description was empty, it uses the other without asking. jj split now lets you specify on the CLI which paths to include in the first commit. The interactive diff-editing is not started when you do that. Sparse checkouts are now supported. In fact, all working copies are now "sparse", only to different degrees. Use the jj sparse command to manage the paths included in the sparse checkout. Configuration is now also read from ~/.jjconfig.toml. The $JJ_CONFIG environment variable can now point to a directory. If it does, all files in the directory will be read, in alphabetical order. The $VISUAL environment is now respected and overrides $EDITOR. The new ui.editor config has higher priority than both of them. There is also a new $JJ_EDITOR environment variable, which has even higher priority than the config. You can now use - and + in revset symbols. You used to have to quote branch names like my-feature in nested quotes (outer layer for your shell) like jj co '"my-feature"'. The quoting is no longer needed. The new revset function connected(x) is the same as x:x. The new revset function roots(x) finds commits in the set that are not descendants of other commits in the set. ssh-agent is now detected even if $SSH_AGENT_PID is not set (as long as $SSH_AUTH_SOCK is set). This should help at least macOS users where ssh-agent is launched by default and only $SSH_AUTH_SOCK is set. When importing from a git, any commits that are no longer referenced on the git side will now be abandoned on the jj side as well. That means that jj git fetch will now abandon unreferenced commits and rebase any local changes you had on top. jj git push gained a --change <revision> argument. When that's used, it will create a branch named after the revision's change ID, so you don't have to create a branch yourself. By default, the branch name will start with push-, but this can be overridden by the push.branch-prefix config setting. jj git push now aborts if you attempt to push a commit without a description or with the placeholder "(no name/email configured)" values for author/committer. Diff editor command arguments can now be specified by config file. Example: [merge-tools.kdiff3] program = "kdiff3" edit-args = ["--merge", "--cs", "CreateBakFiles=0"] jj branch can accept any number of branches to update, rather than just one. Aliases can now call other aliases. jj log now accepts a --reversed option, which will show older commits first. jj log now accepts file paths. jj obslog now accepts -p/--patch option, which will show the diff compared to the previous version of the change. The "(no name/email configured)" placeholder value for name/email will now be replaced if once you modify a commit after having configured your name/email. Color setting can now be overridden by --color=always|never|auto option. jj checkout now lets you specify a description with --message/-m. jj new can now be used for creating merge commits. If you pass more than one argument to it, the new commit will have all of them as parents. Fixed bugs¶ When rebasing a conflict where one side modified a file and the other side deleted it, we no longer automatically resolve it in favor of the modified content (this was a regression from commit c0ae4b16e8c4). Errors are now printed to stderr (they used to be printed to stdout). Updating the working copy to a commit where a file's executable bit changed but the contents was the same used to lead to a crash. That has now been fixed. If one side of a merge modified a directory and the other side deleted it, it used to be considered a conflict. The same was true if both sides added a directory with different files in. They are now merged as if the missing directory had been empty. When using jj move to move part of a commit into an ancestor, any branches pointing to the source commit used to be left on a hidden intermediate commit. They are now correctly updated. jj untrack now requires at least one path (allowing no arguments was a UX bug). jj rebase now requires at least one destination (allowing no arguments was a UX bug). jj restore --to <rev> now restores from the working copy (it used to restore from the working copy's parent). You now get a proper error message instead of a crash when $EDITOR doesn't exist or exits with an error. Global arguments, such as --at-op=<operation>, can now be passed before an alias. Fixed relative path to the current directory in output to be . instead of empty string. When adding a new workspace, the parent of the current workspace's current checkout will be checked out. That was always the intent, but the root commit was accidentally checked out instead. When checking out a commit, the previous commit is no longer abandoned if it has a non-empty description. All commands now consistently snapshot the working copy (it was missing from e.g. jj undo and jj merge before). 0.4.0 - 2022-04-02¶ Breaking changes¶ Dropped support for config in ~/.jjconfig. Your configuration is now read from <config dir>/jj/config.toml, where <config dir> is ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} or ~/.config/ on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/ on macOS, and ~\AppData\Roaming\ on Windows. New features¶ You can now set an environment variable called $JJ_CONFIG to a path to a config file. That will then be read instead of your regular config file. This is mostly intended for testing and scripts. The standard $NO_COLOR environment variable is now respected. jj new now lets you specify a description with --message/-m. When you check out a commit, the old commit no longer automatically gets abandoned if it's empty and has descendants, it only gets abandoned if it's empty and does not have descendants. When undoing an earlier operation, any new commits on top of commits from the undone operation will be rebased away. For example, let's say you rebase commit A so it becomes a new commit A', and then you create commit B on top of A'. If you now undo the rebase operation, commit B will be rebased to be on top of A instead. The same logic is used if the repo was modified by concurrent operations (so if one operation added B on top of A, and one operation rebased A as A', then B would be automatically rebased on top of A'). See #111 for more examples. #111 jj log now accepts -p/--patch option. Fixed bugs¶ Fixed crash on jj init --git-repo=. (it almost always crashed). When sharing the working copy with a Git repo, the automatic importing and exporting (sometimes?) didn't happen on Windows. 0.3.3 - 2022-03-16¶ No changes, only trying to get the automated build to work. 0.3.2 - 2022-03-16¶ No changes, only trying to get the automated build to work. 0.3.1 - 2022-03-13¶ Fixed bugs¶ Fixed crash when core.excludesFile pointed to nonexistent file, and made leading ~/ in that config expand to $HOME/ #131 0.3.0 - 2022-03-12¶ Last release before this changelog started.

• jj git fetch now fetches tags the same way it fetches bookmarks. Tags are fetched as <name>@<remote>, and these remote tags are automatically tracked by local tags of the same name. Running jj git fetch in an existing repository will re-fetch all tags to initialize the tracking state.

    Git's tagOpt is no longer respected. To disable tag fetching, set remotes.<name>.fetch-tags = '~*' in the jj configuration.

blocks.html_en: • Passing an argument more than once is no longer an error. The last occurrence wins, so jj --no-pager --no-pager version and jj log -n 5 -n 10 now work, and an argument baked into an alias or a wrapper can be given explicitly as well. Arguments that can be specified multiple times, such as --config and jj log -r, are unaffected and still collect all of their values. #8101 #9859

blocks.html_en: • Recursive alias definitions are detected more precisely. jj can now expand aliases that are simply repeated. For example, with the alias jj = [], the command jj jj jj will resolve to jj. Aliases can also fall back to the default command. For example, with the alias i = ["--ignore-working-copy"], jj i will resolve to jj --ignore-working-copy.

blocks.html_en: Release highlights¶

sentences.en: Release highlights¶

blocks.html_en: • jj run allows you to run a command over a set of changes, each with their own private working copy; the commands may update the working copy and changes/conflicts are propagated accordingly, e.g., jj run -- cargo check --all-features or jj run -- cargo fix behaves as one might expect.

sentences.en: jj run allows you to run a command over a set of changes, each with their own private working copy; the commands may update the working copy and changes/conflicts are propagated accordingly, e.g., jj run -- cargo check --all-features or jj run -- cargo fix behaves as one might expect.
sentences.zh: jj run 允许您对一组更改运行命令，每个更改都有自己的私有工作副本；这些命令可能会更新工作副本，并相应地传播更改/冲突，例如， jj run -- Cargo check --all-features 或 jj run -- Cargo Fix 的行为如人们所期望的那样。

blocks.html_en: • On Windows, querying a path's file identity no longer follows symbolic links, matching the behavior on Unix. Previously a symlink shared the identity of its target, so two symlinks pointing at the same target were treated as the same file. This identity check is used when writing the working copy to detect aliases of the reserved .git and .jj directories. #8924

sentences.en: On Windows, querying a path's file identity no longer follows symbolic links, matching the behavior on Unix.
sentences.zh: 在 Windows 上，查询路径的文件标识不再遵循符号链接，这与 Unix 上的行为相匹配。

sentences.zh: 以前，符号链接共享其目标的标识，因此指向同一目标的两个符号链接被视为同一文件。

sentences.en: This identity check is used when writing the working copy to detect aliases of the reserved .git and .jj directories. #8924

blocks.html_en: Release highlights¶

sentences.en: Release highlights¶
sentences.zh: 发布亮点¶

blocks.html_en:
• A new syntax for referring to hidden and divergent change IDs is available: xyz/n where n is a number. For instance, xyz/0 refers to the latest version of xyz, while xyz/1 refers to the previous version of xyz. This allows you to perform actions like jj restore --from xyz/1 --to xyz to restore xyz to its previous contents, if you made a mistake.

    For divergent changes, the numeric suffix will always be shown in the log, allowing you to disambiguate them in a similar manner.

sentences.en: A new syntax for referring to hidden and divergent change IDs is available: xyz/n where n is a number.
sentences.zh: 提供了用于引用隐藏和发散的更改 ID 的新语法：xyz/n，其中 n 是数字。

sentences.en: For instance, xyz/0 refers to the latest version of xyz, while xyz/1 refers to the previous version of xyz.
sentences.zh: 例如，xyz/0 指的是 xyz 的最新版本，而 xyz/1 指的是 xyz 的先前版本。

sentences.en: This allows you to perform actions like jj restore --from xyz/1 --to xyz to restore xyz to its previous contents, if you made a mistake.
sentences.zh: 如果您犯了错误，这允许您执行 jj Restore --from xyz/1 --to xyz 等操作，将 xyz 恢复到以前的内容。

sentences.en: For divergent changes, the numeric suffix will always be shown in the log, allowing you to disambiguate them in a similar manner.
sentences.zh: 对于不同的更改，数字后缀将始终显示在日志中，允许您以类似的方式消除它们的歧义。

sentences.en: Deprecations¶

blocks.html_en: • The --destination/-d arguments for jj rebase, jj split, jj revert, etc. were renamed to --onto/-o. The reasoning is that --onto, --insert-before, and --insert-after are all destination arguments, so calling one of them --destination was confusing and unclear. The old names will be removed at some point in the future, but we realize that they are deep in muscle memory, so you can expect an unusually long deprecation period.

sentences.zh: 原因是 --onto、--insert-before 和 --insert-after 都是目标参数，因此调用其中之一 --destination 会令人困惑且不清楚。

sentences.en: The old names will be removed at some point in the future, but we realize that they are deep in muscle memory, so you can expect an unusually long deprecation period.

blocks.html_en: • Workspaces can now have their own separate configuration. For instance, you can use jj config set --workspace to update a configuration option only in the current workspace.

blocks.html_en: Breaking changes¶

sentences.en: Breaking changes¶
sentences.zh: 重大变更¶

blocks.html_en: • In revsets, symbol expressions (such as change ID prefix) no longer resolve to multiple revisions, and error out if resolved to more than one revisions. Use change_id(prefix) or bookmarks(exact:name) to query divergent changes or conflicted bookmarks. Commands like jj rebase no longer require all: to specify multiple destination revisions.

sentences.en: In revsets, symbol expressions (such as change ID prefix) no longer resolve to multiple revisions, and error out if resolved to more than one revisions.
sentences.zh: 在修订集中，符号表达式（例如更改 ID 前缀）不再解析为多个修订版，如果解析为多个修订版，则会出错。

sentences.en: Use change_id(prefix) or bookmarks(exact:name) to query divergent changes or conflicted bookmarks.
sentences.zh: 使用change_id(prefix)或bookmarks(exact:name)来查询不同的更改或冲突的书签。

sentences.en: Commands like jj rebase no longer require all: to specify multiple destination revisions.
sentences.zh: 像 jj rebase 这样的命令不再需要 all: 来指定多个目标修订版。

• jj op abandon now discards previous versions of a change (or predecessors) if they become unreachable from the operation history. The evolution history is truncated accordingly.

    Once jj op abandon and jj util gc are run in a repository, old versions of jj might get "commit not found" error on jj evolog.

sentences.en: jj op abandon now discards previous versions of a change (or predecessors) if they become unreachable from the operation history.
sentences.zh: 如果从操作历史记录中无法访问以前的更改版本（或前身版本），jj op 放弃现在会丢弃它们。

sentences.en: The evolution history is truncated accordingly.
sentences.zh: 演化历史也相应地被截断。

sentences.en: Once jj op abandon and jj util gc are run in a repository, old versions of jj might get "commit not found" error on jj evolog.
sentences.zh: 一旦在存储库中运行 jj op abandon 和 jj util gc，旧版本的 jj 可能会在 jj evolog 上出现“未找到提交”错误。

blocks.html_en: • The experimental support from release 0.29.0 for transferring the change ID to/from Git remotes has been enabled by default. The change ID is stored in the Git commit itself (in a commit header called change-id), which means it will be transferred by regular git push etc. Please let us know if you run into any problems with it. You can disable it setting git.write-change-id-header. Note that some Git remotes (e.g GitLab) and some Git commands (e.g. git rebase) do not preserve the change ids when they rewrite commits.

sentences.en: The experimental support from release 0.29.0 for transferring the change ID to/from Git remotes has been enabled by default.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，从版本 0.29.0 开始，已启用对将更改 ID 传输到 Git 远程服务器或从 Git 远程服务器传输更改 ID 的实验性支持。

sentences.en: You can disable it setting git.write-change-id-header.
sentences.zh: 您可以通过设置 git.write-change-id-header 来禁用它。

sentences.en: Note that some Git remotes (e.g GitLab) and some Git commands (e.g. git rebase) do not preserve the change ids when they rewrite commits.
sentences.zh: 请注意，某些 Git 遥控器（例如 GitLab）和某些 Git 命令（例如 git rebase）在重写提交时不会保留更改 ID。

blocks.html_en: Release highlights¶

sentences.en: Release highlights¶
sentences.zh: 发布亮点¶

blocks.html_en: • Experimental support for transferring the change ID to/from Git remotes behind configuration setting git.write-change-id-header. If this is enabled, the change ID will be stored in the Git commit itself (in a commit header called change-id), which means it will be transferred by regular git push etc. This is an evolving feature that currently defaults to "false". This default will likely change in the future as we gain confidence with forge support and user expectations.

sentences.en: Experimental support for transferring the change ID to/from Git remotes behind configuration setting git.write-change-id-header.
sentences.zh: 实验性支持在配置设置 git.write-change-id-header 后面将更改 ID 传输到 Git 远程服务器或从 Git 远程服务器传输更改 ID。

sentences.en: If this is enabled, the change ID will be stored in the Git commit itself (in a commit header called change-id), which means it will be transferred by regular git push etc. This is an evolving feature that currently defaults to "false".
sentences.zh: 如果启用此功能，更改 ID 将存储在 Git 提交本身中（在称为更改 ID 的提交标头中），这意味着它将通过常规 git Push 等进行传输。这是一项不断发展的功能，目前默认为“false”。

sentences.en: This default will likely change in the future as we gain confidence with forge support and user expectations.
sentences.zh: 随着我们对 Forge 支持和用户期望充满信心，这种默认设置将来可能会发生变化。

blocks.html_en: • git.subprocess is now enabled by default, improving compatibility with Git fetches and pushes by spawning an external git process. Users can opt out of this by setting git.subprocess = false, but this will likely be removed in a future release. Please report any issues you run into.

sentences.en: git.subprocess is now enabled by default, improving compatibility with Git fetches and pushes by spawning an external git process.
sentences.zh: git.subprocess 现在默认启用，通过生成外部 git 进程来提高与 Git 获取和推送的兼容性。

sentences.en: Users can opt out of this by setting git.subprocess = false, but this will likely be removed in a future release.
sentences.zh: 用户可以通过设置 git.subprocess = false 来选择退出，但这可能会在未来的版本中被删除。

sentences.en: Please report any issues you run into.
sentences.zh: 请报告您遇到的任何问题。

sentences.zh: 在共置存储库中，Git 索引现在包含工作副本的所有父级的更改，而不仅仅是第一个父级 (HEAD)。

sentences.en: 2-sided conflicts from the merged parents are now added to the Git index as conflicts as well.
sentences.zh: 来自合并父级的双向冲突现在也作为冲突添加到 Git 索引中。

blocks.html_en: • New ui.conflict-marker-style config option to change how conflicts are materialized in the working copy. The default option ("diff") renders conflicts as a snapshot with a list of diffs to apply to the snapshot. The new "snapshot" option renders conflicts as a series of snapshots, showing each side and base of the conflict. The new "git" option replicates Git's "diff3" conflict style, meaning it is more likely to work with external tools, but it doesn't support conflicts with more than 2 sides.

blocks.html_en: Deprecations¶

sentences.en: Deprecations¶

blocks.html_en:
• jj branch has been deprecated in favor of jj bookmark.

    Rationale: Jujutsu's branches don't behave like Git branches, which a confused many newcomers, as they expected a similar behavior given the name. We've renamed them to "bookmarks" to match the actual behavior, as we think that describes them better, and they also behave similar to Mercurial's bookmarks.

sentences.zh: jj 分支已被弃用，取而代之的是 jj 书签。

sentences.zh: 理由：Jujutsu 的分支的行为与 Git 分支不同，这让许多新手感到困惑，因为他们期望在给定名称的情况下有类似的行为。

sentences.en: We've renamed them to "bookmarks" to match the actual behavior, as we think that describes them better, and they also behave similar to Mercurial's bookmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们将它们重命名为“书签”以匹配实际行为，因为我们认为这样可以更好地描述它们，并且它们的行为也与 Mercurial 的书签类似。

blocks.html_en:
• jj unsquash has been deprecated in favor of jj squash and jj diffedit --restore-descendants.

    Rationale: jj squash can be used in interactive mode to pull changes from one commit to another, including from a parent commit to a child commit. For fine-grained dependent diffs, such as when the parent and the child commits must successively modify the same location in a file, jj diffedit --restore-descendants can be used to set the parent commit to the desired content without altering the content of the child commit.

sentences.zh: jj unsquash 已被弃用，取而代之的是 jj squash 和 jj diffedit --restore-descendants。

sentences.en: Rationale: jj squash can be used in interactive mode to pull changes from one commit to another, including from a parent commit to a child commit.
sentences.zh: 基本原理： jj squash 可以在交互模式下使用，将更改从一个提交拉到另一个提交，包括从父提交到子提交。

sentences.en: For fine-grained dependent diffs, such as when the parent and the child commits must successively modify the same location in a file, jj diffedit --restore-descendants can be used to set the parent commit to the desired content without altering the content of the child commit.
sentences.zh: 对于细粒度的依赖差异，例如当父提交和子提交必须连续修改文件中的同一位置时，可以使用 jj diffedit --restore-descendants 将父提交设置为所需的内容，而不更改子提交的内容。

blocks.html_en:
• Previously, jj git push only made sure that the branch is in the expected location on the remote server when pushing a branch forward (as opposed to sideways or backwards). Now, jj git push makes a safety check in all cases and fails whenever jj git fetch would have introduced a conflict.

    In other words, previously branches that moved sideways or backward were pushed similarly to Git's git push --force; now they have protections similar to git push --force-with-lease (though not identical to it, to match the behavior of jj git fetch). Note also that because of the way jj git fetch works, jj does not suffer from the same problems as Git's git push --force-with-lease in situations when git fetch is run in the background.

sentences.zh: 现在， jj git push 在所有情况下都会进行安全检查，并且每当 jj git fetch 引入冲突时都会失败。

blocks.html_en: Deprecations¶

sentences.en: Deprecations¶

blocks.html_en:
• jj checkout and jj merge are both deprecated; use jj new instead to replace both of these commands in all instances.

    Rationale: jj checkout and jj merge both implement identical functionality, which is a subset of jj new. checkout creates a new working copy commit on top of a single specified revision, i.e. with one parent. merge creates a new working copy commit on top of at least two specified revisions, i.e. with two or more parents.

    The only difference between these commands and jj new, which also creates a new working copy commit, is that new can create a working copy commit on top of any arbitrary number of revisions, so it can handle both the previous cases at once. The only actual difference between these three commands is the command syntax and their name. These names were chosen to be familiar to users of other version control systems, but we instead encourage all users to adopt jj new instead; it is more general and easier to remember than both of these.

    jj checkout and jj merge will no longer be shown as part of jj help, but will still function for now, emitting a warning about their deprecation.

    Deadline: jj checkout and jj merge will be deleted and are expected become a hard error later in 2024.

• Remote branches now have tracking or non-tracking flags. The git.auto-local-branch setting is applied only to newly fetched remote branches. Existing remote branches are migrated as follows:

    • If local branch exists, the corresponding remote branches are considered tracking branches.
    • Otherwise, the remote branches are non-tracking branches.

    If the deduced tracking flags are wrong, use jj branch track/untrack commands to fix them up.

sentences.en: Otherwise, the remote branches are non-tracking branches.
sentences.zh: 否则，远程分支是非跟踪分支。

sentences.en: If the deduced tracking flags are wrong, use jj branch track/untrack commands to fix them up.
sentences.zh: 如果推导的跟踪标志错误，请使用 jj 分支 track/untrack 命令来修复它们。

blocks.html_en: • In revsets, the working-copy or remote symbols (such as @, workspace_id@, and branch@remote) can no longer be quoted as a unit. If a workspace or branch name contains whitespace, quote the name like "branch name"@remote. Also, these symbols will not be resolved as revset aliases or function parameters. For example, author(foo@) is now an error, and the revset alias 'revset-aliases.foo@' = '@' will be failed to parse.

sentences.zh: 此外，这些符号不会被解析为 revset 别名或函数参数。

sentences.en: For example, author(foo@) is now an error, and the revset alias 'revset-aliases.foo@' = '@' will be failed to parse.
sentences.zh: 例如，author(foo@) 现在是一个错误，并且 revset 别名 'revset-aliases.foo@' = '@' 将无法解析。

blocks.html_en: • Change IDs are now rendered using letters from the end of the alphabet (from 'z' through 'k') instead of the usual hex digits ('0' through '9' and 'a' through 'f'). This change doesn't affect the storage format; existing repositories will remain usable.

blocks.html_en: • Open commits are now disabled by default. That means that jj checkout will always create a new change on top of the specified commit and will let you edit that in the working copy. Set ui.enable-open-commits = true to restore the old behavior and let us know that you did so we know how many people prefer the workflow with open commits.

sentences.zh: 现在默认禁用开放提交。

sentences.en: Set ui.enable-open-commits = true to restore the old behavior and let us know that you did so we know how many people prefer the workflow with open commits.

blocks.html_en: • When undoing an earlier operation, any new commits on top of commits from the undone operation will be rebased away. For example, let's say you rebase commit A so it becomes a new commit A', and then you create commit B on top of A'. If you now undo the rebase operation, commit B will be rebased to be on top of A instead. The same logic is used if the repo was modified by concurrent operations (so if one operation added B on top of A, and one operation rebased A as A', then B would be automatically rebased on top of A'). See #111 for more examples. #111

0.44.0 - 2026-08-05¶

发布亮点¶

  • 对获取和推送标签的支持现已稳定。 标签可以像书签一样被跟踪或取消跟踪。 默认情况下会推送跟踪的标签。

重大变更¶

  • jj git fetch 现在以与获取书签相同的方式获取标签。 标签以 <name>@<remote> 的形式获取，这些远程标签将由同名的本地标签自动跟踪。 在现有存储库中运行 jj git fetch 将重新获取所有标签以初始化跟踪状态。 Git 的 tagOpt 不再受到尊重。 要禁用标签获取，请在 jj 配置中设置remotes.<name>.fetch-tags = '~*'。
  • jj git clone --fetch-tags=all|none|included 被删除，取而代之的是 --tag=PATTERN。
  • jj git push --all 现在会推送除书签之外的所有标签。
  • WorkspaceRef.root() 和 RepoPath.absolute() 模板函数现在分别返回 Option<FsPath> 和 FsPath，而不是 String。 jj 配置列表模板中的路径关键字现在返回 Option<FsPath>。
  • jj 文件搜索现在打印以文件路径为前缀的每个匹配行，而不是仅打印包含匹配项的文件的文件路径。 对之前的行为使用 --name-only。第9399章
  • 多次传递参数不再是错误。 最后一次出现获胜，因此 jj --no-pager --no-pager version 和 jj log -n 5 -n 10 现在可以工作，并且也可以显式给出烘焙到别名或包装器中的参数。 可以多次指定的参数（例如 --config 和 jj log -r）不受影响，并且仍然收集它们的所有值。第8101章 第9859章

Deprecations¶

None

新功能¶

  • 新的 merge_point() revset 函数（类似于 fork_point）找到多个分支合并的点。
  • jj 工作区列表现在默认显示工作区根。 可以使用 templates.workspace_list 或 -T 自定义输出，并且 WorkspaceRef.root() 返回可选的 FsPath 值。第9713章，第9826章
  • 新尝试（expr、后备...） 用于抑制运行时错误的模板函数。
  • jj run 现在默认处理从最旧到最新的修订。 启动顺序得到保证：每个修订版仅在前一个修订版启动后才开始执行，即使 --jobs 高于 1。
  • jj run 获得了一个 --passthrough 标志，它将子进程的 stdout/stderr 直接连接到终端，而不是捕获输出。
  • jj run 获得了 --ignore-changes 标志，以避免编辑任何修订，即使命令修改了工作副本也是如此。
  • jj run 获得了 --ignore-errors 标志，即使命令以非零退出代码退出，也可以继续针对剩余修订运行。
  • jj 文件搜索现在支持 -n/--line-number 在文件中为每个匹配项添加从 1 开始的行号作为前缀。
  • jj git push 获得了 --allow-conflicts 标志以允许推送包含冲突的提交。
  • 新的 jj 标签跟踪/取消跟踪命令可将本地标签与远程标签关联起来。 请注意，默认情况下会跟踪获取的标签。
  • 为内置默认 jj 日志修订集添加了builtin_log() 修订集别名。 revsets.log 现在默认为builtin_log()，因此自定义日志revsets 可以重用内置默认值，而不是复制其完整表达式。
  • 添加了配置选项 diff.stat.max-bar-width 与 --stat 一起使用来限制 ++-- 条形宽度。 在模板语言中， diff.stat() 可以选择采用第二个（位置或命名）参数 max_bar_width 以获得等效效果。
  • jj吸收现在支持--interactive/-i/--tool，让您交互式地选择源中的哪些帅哥要考虑吸收。 当您只想吸收提交的一部分而不首先拆分它时，这非常有用。 任何未选择或无法吸收的块都会保留在源提交中。

修复了错误¶

  • 可以更精确地检测递归别名定义。 jj 现在可以扩展简单重复的别名。 例如，使用别名 jj = []，命令 jj jj jj 将解析为 jj。 别名也可以回退到默认命令。 例如，使用别名 i = ["--ignore-working-copy"]，jj i 将解析为 jj --ignore-working-copy。
  • 现在，在存在信号（例如 Ctrl-C）的情况下，可以更可靠地清理 Git 临时文件。 这应该会降低“无法获取索引文件的锁”错误的发生率。 (#7530)
  • 修复了工作副本变得不可变后 Git HEAD 不匹配的问题。第9827章
  • 现在，一旦当前工作空间变得不可变，以及在快照期间，jj 就会创建一个新的工作副本修订版。 这使得行为更接近 jj 0.42 及更早版本。
  • 如果工作副本包含名称不是有效 UTF-8 的路径，快照不再失败。 无法跟踪此类路径，因此现在会跳过它们并报告为警告。第9774章
  • 修复了使用空的存储库级别配置目录读取复制的存储库中的配置时出现的故障。
  • 当重命名的源存在于多个父级中时，jj diff 和 jj status 不再省略合并提交中的重命名或副本。 为每个家长报告的相同副本记录被误认为存在冲突并被丢弃。第9752章
  • 当 jj run 的 revset 包含冲突的提交时，不再出现恐慌。 冲突现在保留在重写的提交中。第9747章
  • 修复了将过大长度参数传递给 ID 模板器函数（commit_id.short()、commit_id.shortest() 等）时出现的恐慌。第9833章
  • 现在默认禁用并置工作区中的 jj git 导入和导出。 这些命令通常不执行任何操作，但它们有竞争条件。

0.43.0 - 2026-07-01¶

发布亮点¶

  • jj run 允许您对一组更改运行命令，每个更改都有自己的私有工作副本；这些命令可能会更新工作副本，并相应地传播更改/冲突，例如， jj run -- Cargo check --all-features 或 jj run -- Cargo Fix 的行为如人们所期望的那样。

重大变更¶

  • 已弃用的 git_head() 和 git_refs() 函数已从修订集和模板中删除。
  • 类似 Git 的符号（例如 refs/heads/main）不再解析为修订版。 请改用书签/标签 <name> 或 <name>@<remote> 语法。
  • 已弃用的 ui.revsets-use-glob-by-default 选项已被删除。
  • jj 书签 track/untrack 不再支持 <kind>:<bookmark>@<remote> 模式。 但是，仍然支持 <bookmark>@<remote> 符号语法。第9226章

Deprecations¶

新功能¶

  • jj show 现在支持 --reversed 标志。
  • jj 现在在 /etc/jj 中查找配置文件。
  • jj config gc 将从 ~/.config/jj/repos 文件夹中删除已删除/移动的存储库的配置。第9362章
  • jj run 允许您对一组更改运行命令，每个更改都有自己的私有工作副本；这些命令可能会更新工作副本，并相应地传播更改/冲突，例如， jj run -- Cargo check --all-features 或 jj run -- Cargo Fix 的行为如人们所期望的那样。
  • jj gerrit upload 现在支持 -o (--option) 标志，其工作方式类似于 git push -o (--push-option)。
  • jj git fetch 现在对根据更改 ID 重写的修订版本的后代进行变基。 以前，当堆栈中存在多个带​​书签的修订时，这些重写的修订及其后代并不总是会被重新设置基准。 请注意，不可变的后代不会被重新设置基础。
  • 添加一个 forks() revset 函数，该函数生成具有超过 1 个子级的所有提交。
  • 颜色配置现在支持使用 { crossed-out = true } 划掉文本样式。

修复了错误¶

  • 在 Windows 上，查询路径的文件标识不再遵循符号链接，这与 Unix 上的行为相匹配。 以前，符号链接共享其目标的标识，因此指向同一目标的两个符号链接被视为同一文件。 在编写工作副本时使用此身份检查来检测保留的 .git 和 .jj 目录的别名。第8924章
  • 如果工作副本不可变，jj 现在会在快照期间创建新的工作副本修订版。 以前，新版本是在工作副本变得不可变后立即创建的。第7751章 第9338章
  • jj git remote add 现在会警告新远程是否与现有远程的获取 URL 或有效推送 URL 完全匹配。第413章
  • 修复了 Intel Raptor Lake CPU 和 aarch64 上损坏的松散 Git 对象。 以前，jj 可以报告成功的提交，即使 git fsck 稍后会因数据检查不正确、松散对象损坏或丢失 blob 而失败，并且稍后的 jj 操作可能会因损坏的 deflate 流而失败。

0.42.0 - 2026-06-04¶

发布亮点¶

  • 切换到mimalloc内存分配器以获得更好的多线程性能。

重大变更¶

  • 以下已弃用的命令选项已被删除： jj commit --reset-author/--author jj describe --no-edit/--edit/--reset-author/--author jj git push --allow-new jj metaedit --update-committer-timestamp
  • 以下已弃用的配置选项已被删除： git.auto-local-bookmark git.push-new-bookmarks

Deprecations¶

  • jj evolog 不再支持 jj < 0.30 中记录的旧版提交前趋。

新功能¶

  • Shell 补全现在显示自定义别名、revset-aliases、template-aliases 和 fileset-aliases 的描述。 如果别名定义是具有 .doc 和 .definition 属性的表，则从别名定义的 .doc 字段中提取描述。
  • jj show 现在接受多个修订，一个接一个地显示所有修订，表现更接近 git show。
  • jj git fetch 现在根据更改 ID 生成演化历史记录。 如果更改 ID 由远程保留，则本地后代修订将重新基于重写的父版本。
  • 添加了 jj util backend name 命令，用于打印当前存储库中使用的提交后端。
  • 为 diff 编辑器添加了编辑调用模式配置选项（例如 jj diffedit、jj split）。 当设置为“逐个文件”时，每个更改的文件都会启动编辑器一次，从而可以使用 vimdiff 等每个文件的工具进行编辑。

修复了错误¶

  • jj git Remote add 现在会在远程名称为空或包含空格时报告错误，而不是出现恐慌。第9099章
  • 当禁用颜色输出时，颜色词差异现在显示为单独的行前和行后，从而使管道或重定向的差异可读。第5894章
  • jj 书签忘记不再打印忘记 N 个本地书签。 当实际上没有忘记任何本地书签时（例如，当仅匹配未跟踪的远程书签时）。第9181章
  • builtin_log_redacted 模板现在还可以编辑工作区名称。

0.41.0 - 2026-05-06¶

发布亮点¶

  • jj fix 现在支持格式化特定的行范围（允许您仅格式化修改的行）；有关更多信息，请参阅配置手册和下面的注释。
  • 新的全局标志 --no-integrate-operation 将允许您运行命令而不影响存储库状态或工作副本，这在自动化工具可能在后台创建快照时非常有用。

重大变更¶

  • 文件搜索的 --pattern 标志现在默认为 regex: 而不是 glob:。
  • jj git push --all/--tracked/-r 当推送的修订是私有的或有冲突时，REVSETS 不再失败。 不符合推送条件的书签将被跳过。
  • 传递给 jj git clone 的分支/书签模式现在保存到 jj 的存储库设置文件而不是 .git/config。 Git fetch refspecs 设置为默认值。

Deprecations¶

  • 在模板语言中，Operation 类型的 .tags() 函数已被弃用，取而代之的是 .attributes()。

新功能¶

  • 文件搜索的 --pattern 标志现在通过 kind:pattern 语法接受各种模式类型。
  • 新的全局标志 --no-integrate-operation 允许您运行命令，而不会影响存储库状态或工作副本。
  • 新的配置选项 diff.git.show-path-prefix 可用于抑制 diff --git 输出中的 a/ 和 b/ 路径前缀。
  • jj fix 现在通过 fix.tools.<name>.line-range-arg 和 run-tool-if-zero-line-ranges 配置支持行范围限制格式。 这允许仅在修改的行上运行工具，并在工具运行时进行细粒度控制。 如果您已设置 line-range-arg 配置，请使用 --all-lines 来匹配之前格式化整个文件的行为。
  • 添加了新的 Replace(pattern, content, replacement) 模板函数，该函数支持替换模板中的内容，使用 lambda 来格式化替换文本。 它支持所有字符串模式，包括带有捕获组的正则表达式（例如，replace(regex:'(\w+) (\w+)', "hello world", |c| c.get(1) ++ " " ++ c.get(2))）。
  • 用于文件内容等内容的新 ByteString 模板类型。
  • jj gerrit upload 现在支持新选项 --message (-m)、--edit 和 --merged。 您现在还可以通过重复 --hashtag 选项来传递多个主题标签。
  • 新的 remotes.<name>.fetch-bookmarks/fetch-tags 选项用于配置默认获取目标。
  • JJ_PAGER 现在可以覆盖 ui.pager 配置，为需要 jj 特定环境覆盖的调用者匹配 JJ_EDITOR。

修复了错误¶

  • 提高 git 处理 .gitignore 的一致性，包括条目后的 / 和 MacOS 文件的 \r\r\n。
  • jj status 按文件集过滤未跟踪的路径 #9287

0.39.0 - 2026-03-04¶

发布亮点¶

  • jj排列命令会弹出一个TUI，您可以在其中重新排序和放弃修订。第1531章
  • jj 书签前进使用自定义点 revsets.bookmark-advance-from 和 revsets.bookmark-advance-to 自动将书签向前移动到目标修订版（默认为 @）。 它的灵感很大程度上来自于长期存在的社区别名 jj tug。

重大变更¶

  • 不再支持 jj < 0.33 编写的旧索引文件。 将根据需要创建新的索引文件。
  • 以下已弃用的配置选项已被删除： core.fsmonitor core.watchman.register-snapshot-trigger
  • 已弃用的命令 jj op undo 已被删除。 请改用 jj op revert 或 jj undo/redo。

Deprecations¶

  • jj 调试快照已弃用，取而代之的是 jj util 快照。 尽管这本来就是一个未记录的命令，但它将在 6 个月（v0.45.0）后删除，以便人们有时间迁移。

新功能¶

  • 使用 --option 标志在 jj git push 中添加对推送选项的支持。 这允许用户在推送提交时将选项传递到远程服务器。 还支持短别名 -o。
  • jj new 现在在未提供 -m 消息时评估 new_description 模板以填充初始提交描述。
  • 模板现在支持列表类型上的first()、last()、get(index)、reverse()、skip(count) 和take(count) 方法，以实现更灵活的列表操作。
  • 新的builtin_draft_commit_description_with_diff 模板包含提交描述编辑器中的差异，从而可以在编写提交消息时更轻松地查看更改。
  • Revsets 和模板现在支持 name:x 模式别名，例如 'grep:x' = 'description(regex:x)'。
  • 文件集现在支持用户别名。
  • jj 工作区现在添加带有相对路径的链接。 这使得工作空间可以在容器内工作或一起移动。 具有绝对路径的现有工作区将继续像以前一样工作。
  • 除了恢复的操作之外，jj undo 现在还输出撤消的操作。
  • 具有两个或多个连续 - 字符的书签不再需要在转集中引用。 例如，jj diff -r '"foo--bar"' 现在可以写为 jj diff -r foo--bar。
  • jj rebase 上的新标志 --simplify-parents 可以在 rebase 提交上应用与 jj Simply-parents 相同的转换。第7711章
  • 如果给定参数解析为空修订集， jj rebase --branch 和 jj rebase --source 将不再返回错误（jj rebase --revisions 已经这样做了）。 相反，将打印一条消息来通知用户为什么没有任何变化。
  • 更改了冲突提交的 Git 表示形式，以包含冲突第一方的文件。 在检查共置工作区中的冲突提交时，这应该可以防止未更改的文件在编辑器中突出显示为“已添加”。
  • 新模板函数 Timestamp::since(ts) 返回两个时间戳之间的 TimestampRange。 它可以与 .duration() 结合使用，以获得两个时间戳之间的人类友好的持续时间。
  • 添加了新的 jj util snapshot 命令以手动或以编程方式触发快照。 这引入了先前未记录的 jj debug snapshot 命令的官方替代方案。 Watchman 集成也已更新为使用此命令。
  • 更改了后台快照以抑制 stdout 和 stderr 以避免长时间挂起。
  • jj gerrit upload 现在支持 gerrit 文档中记录的各种新标志。 例如，这包括 --reviewer=foo@example.com 和 --label=Auto-Submit。
  • jj gerrit upload 现在可以识别通过备用预告片链接显式设置的 Change-Id，并且如果设置了 gerrit.review-url 选项，将生成一个链接：<review-url>/id/<change-id> 预告片。
  • jj gerrit upload 不再需要 -r 标志，并且将默认上传您当前正在处理的内容。
  • 当基础类型支持时，模板现在支持对 map() 和 if() 结果进行序列化操作。
  • jj 书签重命名现在支持 --overwrite-existing 以允许重命名书签，即使新名称已经存在，从而有效地替换现有书签。
  • 基于环境变量的条件配置 --when.environments。第8779章

修复了错误¶

  • Windows：使用本机文件锁 (LockFileEx)，而不是轮询文件创建，修复“待删除”语义导致锁定文件卡住的问题。
  • 现在，如果在 Git 导出期间移动或删除了备用 Git 工作树的签出分支，jj 现在可以安全地分离备用 Git 工作树的 HEAD。
  • jj 文件跟踪 --include-ignored 现在在 fsmonitor.backend="watchman" 时工作。第8427章

0.38.0 - 2026-02-04¶

发布亮点¶

  • 出于安全原因，每个存储库和每个工作空间的配置现在存储在存储库外部。 这不是重大更改，因为我们会自动将旧存储库迁移到这种新格式。不应再使用 .jj/repo/config.toml 和 .jj/workspace-config.toml。

重大变更¶

  • 现在支持的最低 git 命令版本是 2.41.0。 macOS 用户需要将“开发人员工具”升级到 26 或从例如 macOS 安装 Git。自制。
  • 已弃用的 ui.always-allow-large-revsets 设置和 all: revset 修饰符已被删除。
  • <name>@<remote> revset 符号也可以解析为远程标记。 标签的优先级高于书签。
  • 用于取消设置 user.name 或 user.email 的旧占位符支持已被删除。 现在将使用 jj git push 推送包含这些值的提交，而不会产生错误。
  • 如果冲突文件的任何一侧缺少终止换行符，则工作副本中的具体化文件将不再由换行符终止。

Deprecations¶

  • 转速集函数 diff_contains() 已重命名为 diff_lines()。

新功能¶

  • jj git fetch 现在默认显示放弃的提交的详细信息（更改 ID 和描述），与 jj 放弃输出格式匹配。第3081章
  • jj 工作空间根现在接受可选的 --name 参数来显示指定工作空间的根路径（默认为当前路径）。 当给定在此版本之前创建的工作区时，会出错。
  • jj git push --bookmark <name> 现在将自动跟踪书签（如果尚未使用任何遥控器进行跟踪）。
  • 添加 git_web_url([remote]) 模板函数，将 git 远程 URL 转换为适合在浏览器中打开的 Web URL。 默认为“原始”遥控器。
  • 新的 divergent() revset 函数可用于不同的更改。
  • 转速集和模板中的字符串模式值现在可以用别名替换。 例如，grep(x) = description(regex:x) 现在可以使用。
  • 新的配置选项remotes.<name>.auto-track-created-bookmarks 的行为与auto-track-bookmarks 类似，但它仅适用于本地创建的书签。 将其设置为“*”现在是已弃用的 git.push-new-bookmarks 选项的最接近替代品。
  • jj 标签列表现在可以通过 revset 进行过滤。
  • 冲突标记将根据文件内容使用 LF 或 CRLF 作为行结尾。第7376章
  • 新的实验性 jj git fetch --tag 标志以与书签相同的方式获取标签。 如果指定，则不会隐式获取标签，并且只有与模式匹配的标签才会作为 <name>@<remote> 标签获取。 获取的远程标签将由同名的本地标签跟踪。
  • 新的remote_tags() revset函数用于查询远程标签。
  • 新的内置 hyperlink() 模板函数在输出到非终端时可以优雅地回退到文本，而不是发出原始 OSC 8 转义码。第7592章

修复了错误¶

  • jj git init --colocate 现在拒绝在 Git 工作树内运行，提供有用的错误消息和替代方案。第8052章
  • jj git Push 现在可以确保更新跟踪的远程书签，即使 Git 获取引用规范中没有映射也是如此。第5115章
  • jj git fetch/push 现在转发大多数 git stderr 输出，例如身份验证请求。第5760章
  • trunk() 中冲突的书签和标签将不再生成详细警告。 配置的 trunk() 别名将暂时被禁用。第8501章
  • jj config unset 的动态 shell 完成现在仅完成已设置的配置选项。第7774章
  • 动态 shell 完成不再尝试解析完成位置的别名。 此前，这阻止了某些 shell 接受完整类型的别名，并用 bash 上的扩展完全替换了它。 现在，在光标前进到下一个位置后，补全只会解析别名，并相应地建议候选者。第7773章
  • 通过 ui.editor、$EDITOR 或 JJ_EDITOR 设置编辑器现在支持 shell 引用。
  • 如果更改未能推送到 gerrit，jj gerrit upload 将不再吞咽错误并浮出水面。第8568章
  • 现在，从具有不同冲突标签的提交恢复文件时，可以正确保留冲突标签。
  • 现在，当工作副本为空时，总是会写入空树。第8480章
  • 使用 Watchman 文件系统监视器时，对 .gitignore 的更改现在会触发对受影响子树的扫描，以便发现新的未忽略的文件。第8427章
  • jj file track --include-ignored 成功跟踪文件后不再显示虚假的“大文件”警告。第8826章
  • --quiet 现在隐藏进度条。

0.37.0 - 2026-01-07¶

发布亮点¶

  • 提供了用于引用隐藏和发散的更改 ID 的新语法：xyz/n，其中 n 是数字。 例如，xyz/0 指的是 xyz 的最新版本，而 xyz/1 指的是 xyz 的先前版本。 如果您犯了错误，这允许您执行 jj Restore --from xyz/1 --to xyz 等操作，将 xyz 恢复到以前的内容。 对于不同的更改，数字后缀将始终显示在日志中，允许您以类似的方式消除它们的歧义。

重大变更¶

  • 默认情况下，转速集、命令参数和配置中的字符串模式现在被解析为 glob。 根据需要使用 substring: 或 exact: 前缀。
  • 现在，remotes.<name>.auto-track-bookmarks 的解析方式与转速集中的方式相同，并且可以与逻辑运算符组合。
  • jj 书签 track/untrack 现在接受 --remote 参数。 如果省略，则将跟踪/取消跟踪与书签名称匹配的所有远程书签。 旧的 <bookmark>@<remote> 语法已被弃用，取而代之的是 <bookmark> --remote=<remote>。
  • 在 Windows 上，不支持指向带有 / 的路径的符号链接。 该路径在 Windows 上无效。
  • 模板别名 format_short_change_id_with_hidden_​​and_divergent_info(commit) 已替换为 format_short_change_id_with_change_offset(commit)。
  • 以下已弃用的配置选项已被删除： git.push-bookmark-prefix ui.default-description ui.diff.format ui.diff.tool
  • 已弃用的 commit_id.normal_hex() 模板方法已被删除。
  • 不产生终止换行符的模板扩展将不会被修复以通过 jj log、jj evolog 或 jj op log 提供一个。
  • diff 冲突标记样式现在可以使用 \\\\\\\ 标记来指示冲突标签与上一行的延续。

Deprecations¶

  • git_head() 和 git_refs() 函数将从修订集和模板中删除。 git_head() 应该指向并置存储库中的first_parent(@) 修订版。 git_refs() 可以近似为remote_bookmarks(remote=glob:*) |标签（）。

新功能¶

  • 如果未找到配置值，config() 模板函数现在会返回 Option<ConfigValue>，而不是失败。 这允许检查配置是否存在（例如 if(config("user.email"), ...)）。
  • 更新了本地工作副本中的可执行位表示，以允许忽略 Unix 上的可执行位更改。 默认情况下，我们尝试检测文件系统的行为，但这可以通过设置working-copy.exec-bit-change = "respect" | 手动覆盖。 “忽略”。
  • jj 工作空间添加现在也适用于空目标目录。
  • jj git Remote 系列命令现在支持不同的获取和推送 URL。
  • [colors] 表现在支持 dim = true 属性。
  • 在颜色词差异中，上下文行号现在以降低的强度呈现。
  • 现在可以使用其更改 ID 与数字后缀相结合来明确选择隐藏和发散的提交。 例如，如果有两个更改 ID 为 xyz 的提交，则其中一个可称为 xyz/0，另一个可称为 xyz/1。 必要时，这些后缀会显示在日志中，以使更改 ID 明确。
  • jj util gc 现在会修剪 .jj/repo/store/extra 中无法访问的文件以节省磁盘空间。
  • jj 文件搜索命令的早期版本，用于搜索文件中的模式（如 git grep）。
  • 冲突标签现在包含有关冲突双方来自何处的信息（例如 nlqwxzwn 7dd24e73“第一行描述”）。
  • --insert-before 现在接受与 --insert-after 一起使用时解析为空集的转速集。 其行为类似于 --onto。
  • jj 标签列表现在支持 --sort 选项。
  • TreeDiffEntry 类型现在有一个 display_diff_path() 方法，可以适当地格式化重命名/复制。
  • TreeDiffEntry 现在有一个 status_char() 方法，该方法返回单字符状态代码 (M/A/D/C/R)。
  • CommitEvolutionEntry 类型现在有一个previouss() 方法，该方法返回条目提交的前任提交（以前的版本）。
  • CommitEvolutionEntry 类型现在有一个 inter_diff() 方法，该方法返回条目的提交与其前身版本之间的 TreeDiff。 可以选择接受文件集文字来限制差异。
  • jj 文件注释现在报告非文件错误，而不是成功且不显示任何内容。
  • jjworkspaceforget 现在会警告未知的工作空间，而不是失败。

修复了错误¶

  • Windows 上的符号链接损坏。第6934章
  • 修复了将移动/删除的带注释标签导出到 Git 时失败的问题。 移动的标签将导出为轻量级标签。
  • jj gerrit upload 现在可以正确处理提交链中的混合显式和隐式 Change-Id (#8219)
  • jj git push 现在会相应地更新部分推送的远程书签。第6787章
  • 修复了加载大型 Git 包文件的问题。 https://github.com/GitoxideLabs/gitoxide/issues/2265
  • 当 stdin 重定向时，内置寻呼机不会卡住。
  • jj 工作空间添加现在可以防止创建空工作空间名称。
  • 修复了 Unix 上指向自身或 .git/.jj 的符号链接的签出。 如果启用符号链接，该问题在 Windows 上仍然存在。第8348章
  • 修复了 jj 无法从包文件中读取 git delta 对象的错误。 https://github.com/GitoxideLabs/gitoxide/issues/2344

0.36.0 - 2025-12-03¶

发布亮点¶

  • 该文档已从 https://jj-vcs.github.io/jj/ 移至 https://docs.jj-vcs.dev/。 301 重定向正在向新域发出，因此不应破坏任何现有链接。
  • 修复了在共置存储库中运行并发 jj 命令时可能导致不同操作的竞争条件。 现在连续运行是安全的，例如当您在另一个终端中运行其他命令时，在一个终端中不使用 --ignore-working-copy 进行 jj 日志。第6830章
  • jj 现在忽略环境中设置的 $PAGER 并在大多数平台上使用较少的 -FRX（Windows 上的：builtin）。 请参阅文档以获取更多信息，并参阅 #3502 以了解动机。

重大变更¶

  • 在文件集或路径模式中，默认情况下启用全局匹配。 您可以使用 cwd:"path" 来匹配文字路径。
  • 在以下命令中，字符串模式参数现在以与转速集中相同的方式进行解析，并且可以与逻辑运算符组合：jj 书签删除/忘记/列表/移动、jj 标签删除/列表、jj git 克隆/获取/推送
  • 在以下命令中，不匹配的书签/标签名称不再是错误。 将打印警告：jj bookmark delete/forget/move/track/untrack、jj tag delete、jj git clone/push
  • 在未来的版本中，revset 中的默认字符串模式语法将更改为 glob:。 您可以通过设置 ui.revsets-use-glob-by-default=true 来选择新的默认值。
  • 将 scm-record 从 v0.8.0 升级到 v0.9.0。 请参阅 https://github.com/arxanas/scm-record/releases/tag/v0.9.0 上的发行说明。
  • 现在支持的最低 Rust 版本 (MSRV) 是 1.89。
  • 在 macOS 上，不再读取已弃用的配置目录 ~/Library/Application Support/jj。 使用 $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/jj 代替（默认为 ~/.config/jj）。
  • 不再跟踪子存储库。 任何包含 .jj 或 .git 的目录都会被忽略。 请注意，Git 子模块不受此影响。

Deprecations¶

  • jj rebase、jj split、jj revert 等的 --destination/-d 参数已重命名为 --onto/-o。 原因是 --onto、--insert-before 和 --insert-after 都是目标参数，因此调用其中之一 --destination 会令人困惑且不清楚。 旧名称将在未来的某个时候被删除，但我们意识到它们深深地存在于肌肉记忆中，因此您可以预期一个异常长的弃用期。
  • jj describe --edit 已弃用，取而代之的是 --editor。
  • 配置选项 git.auto-local-bookmark 和 git.push-new-bookmarks 已弃用，取而代之的是 remotes.<name>.auto-track-bookmarks。 例如： [remotes.origin] auto-track-bookmarks = "glob:*" 有关更多详细信息，请参阅文档。
  • jj git push 上的标志 --allow-new 已弃用。 为了推送新书签，请使用 jj 书签轨道进行跟踪。 或者，考虑设置自动跟踪配置以避免手动跟踪书签的繁琐工作。 例如： [remotes.origin] auto-track-bookmarks = "glob:*" 有关更多详细信息，请参阅文档。

新功能¶

  • jj commit、jjdescribe、jjsquash 和 jjsplit 现在接受 --editor，这确保即使通过 --message/-m 提供了编辑器，也将使用提交描述打开编辑器。
  • 当提供的文件集表达式与任何文件都不匹配时，所有 jj 命令都会显示警告。
  • 向 DiffStats 添加了 files() 模板函数。 这支持每个文件的统计信息，例如lines_added()和lines_removed()
  • 添加了 join() 模板函数。 这与 split() 不同，因为它在所有参数之间添加分隔符，即使为空也是如此。
  • RepoPath 模板类型现在具有absolute() -> String 方法，该方法以字符串形式返回绝对路径。
  • 添加了 format_path(path) 模板别名，用于控制如何使用 jj 文件列表打印文件路径。
  • 新的内置转速集别名visible()和hidden()。
  • 现在转速集中允许不带引号的 *。 bookmarks(glob:foo*) 不再需要引用。
  • 如果工作副本有一些子副本，jj prev/next --no-edit 现在会生成错误。
  • 新的配置选项remotes.<name>.auto-track-bookmarks 可以设置为字符串模式。 将自动跟踪指定遥控器的与其匹配的新书签。 请参阅文档。
  • jj log 现在支持 --count 标志来打印提交数量而不是显示它们。
  • 提交类型现在有一个冲突的_files() 方法，该方法返回具有合并冲突的文件列表。
  • TreeEntry 类型现在有一个conflict_side_count() 方法，该方法返回合并冲突中的边数（对于非冲突文件为1，对于冲突为2 或更多）。

修复了错误¶

  • 如果工具无法在文件上运行，jj fix 现在会打印警告。第7971章
  • Shell 完成现在适用于非规范化路径，修复了之前的恐慌并允许包含 . 或者 .. 才能正确完成。第6861章
  • Shell 完成现在始终使用正斜杠来完成路径，即使在 Windows 上也是如此。 这使得在 Git Bash 中使用 jj 时完成结果可行。第7024章
  • 现在，意外的关键字参数会返回 coalesce() 和 concat() 模板函数的解析失败。
  • Nushell 完成脚本文档添加 -f 选项，以保持最新。第8007章
  • 确保使用 Git 子模块时，运行 jj new 后子模块的剩余部分不会显示在工作副本中。第4349章

0.35.0 - 2025-11-05¶

发布亮点¶

  • 工作区现在可以有自己的单独配置。 例如，您可以使用 jj config set --workspace 仅更新当前工作区中的配置选项。
  • 创建本地书签后，现在可以使用 jj 书签轨道将书签与特定的远程书签关联起来，然后再推送它。 推送跟踪书签时，无需使用 --allow-new。
  • 新的 jj git colocation enable 和 jj git colocation disable 命令允许在共置工作区和非共置工作区之间进行转换。

重大变更¶

  • 如果指定的模式与 git 匹配，remote_bookmarks(remote=pattern) 修订集现在包含 Git 跟踪书签。 默认值是remote=~exact:"git" 和以前一样。
  • jj 放弃的已弃用标志 --summary 已被删除。
  • 已弃用的命令 jj backout 已被删除，请改用 jj revert。
  • 以下已弃用的配置选项已被删除：signing.sign-all core.watchman.register_snapshot_trigger diff.format

Deprecations¶

  • jj bisect run --command <cmd> 已弃用，取而代之的是 jj bisect run -- <cmd>。
  • jj metaedit --update-committer-timestamp 已重命名为 jj metaedit --force-rewrite，因为旧名称（和帮助文本）错误地表明提交者姓名和电子邮件不会更新。

新功能¶

  • 工作区可能有一个额外的分层配置，位于 .jj/workspace-config.toml。 采用 --repo 等层选项的 jj config 子命令现在也支持 --workspace。
  • jj 书签轨道现在可以将新的本地书签与远程书签关联起来。 跟踪的书签可以在没有 --allow-new 的情况下推送。第7072章
  • 新的 jj git colocation 命令提供了子命令来显示并置状态 (status)、将非并置工作空间转换为并置工作空间 (启用)，反之亦然 (禁用)。
  • 新的 jj 标签设置/删除命令可在本地创建/更新/删除标签。 创建/更新的标签当前始终作为轻量级标签导出到 Git。 如果您希望将它们导出为带注释的标签，请向我们提供有关 #7908 的反馈。
  • 模板现在支持字符串上的 .split(separator, [limit]) 方法，将字符串拆分为子字符串列表。
  • -G 现在在 jj log、jj evolog、jj op log、jj op show 和 jj op diff 中以 --no-graph 的缩写形式提供。
  • jj metaedit 现在接受 -m/--message 选项以非交互方式更新更改描述。
  • CryptographicSignature.key() 模板方法现在也适用于 SSH 签名并返回相应的公钥指纹。
  • 添加了 template-aliases.empty_commit_marker。 用户可以在其配置中覆盖此值，以更改空提交上的“（空）”标签。
  • 添加对 --when.workspaces 配置范围的支持。
  • 添加对 --when.hostnames 配置范围的支持。 这允许根据在操作.主机名中设置的主机名有条件地应用配置。
  • jj bisect run 接受命令和参数作为位置参数直接传递给命令，例如 jj bisect run --range=..main -- Cargo check --all-targets。
  • 在不可变修订中，不同的更改不再标记为红色。 由于修订版是不可变的，用户不应该采取任何操作，因此红色不必要地引起警报。
  • 新提交模板关键字 local/remote_tags 仅显示本地/远程标签。 这些关键字在非共置 Git 存储库中可能很有用，其中本地和导出的 @git 标签可以指向不同的修订版本。
  • jj git clone 现在支持 --branch 选项来指定克隆期间要获取的分支。 如果存在，则第一个匹配分支将用作工作副本父级。
  • Revset 现在支持字符串模式中的逻辑运算符。
  • jj 文件跟踪现在接受 --include-ignored 标志来跟踪 .gitignore 忽略或超出 snapshot.max-new-file-size 限制的文件。第2837章

修复了错误¶

  • jj metaedit --author-timestamp 两次使用相同的值在某些情况下不再编辑更改两次。
  • jj squash：修复了同时使用 --insert-after 和 --insert-before 时不正确的修订变基。
  • jj 撤消现在可以恢复涉及标签更新的“获取”/“导入”操作。第6325章
  • 修复了文件（expr）revset表达式（包括括号）的解析。第7747章
  • 修复了 jj describe --stdin 以附加最后的换行符。

0.34.0 - 2025-10-01¶

发布亮点¶

  • 支持使用 jj gerrit upload 将更改上传到 Gerrit Code Review。 这使您可以一次提交树或多堆工作。 尚未实现对获取更改、提交更改和其他操作的支持。 这应该被视为实验性的，我们欢迎有关使用它的反馈。
  • 支持使用 jj bisect run 自动二分；这将连续平分提交范围，直到发现给定的提交触发错误。

重大变更¶

  • 基于 Git 的存储库现在默认位于同一位置。 配置 git.colocate = false 以保留之前的行为。
  • 不再支持 jj < 0.11 写入的冲突。 它们现在将显示为带有 .jjconflict 后缀和 JSON 内容的常规文件。
  • 现在支持的最低 Rust 版本 (MSRV) 是 1.88。

Deprecations¶

  • jj描述和jj提交上的各种标志已被弃用，以支持jj元编辑。 它们是： 描述：--author、--reset-author、--no-edit 提交：--author、--reset-author
  • 远程书签和标签的存储格式已更改。 远程书签将以新旧格式写入，以保持向前兼容性。 还记录了 Git 跟踪标记，以供将来的本机标记支持。 此更改应该是透明的，但如果您发现任何奇怪的情况，请告诉我们。

新功能¶

  • 新命令 jj bisect run 使用二分搜索来查找引入错误的提交。
  • Unix 上的默认编辑器现在是 nano 而不是 pico。
  • 新的配置选项 merge.hunk-level = "word" 以启用单词级合并。
  • 新的配置选项 merge.same-change = "keep" 用于禁用相同更改冲突的有损解决规则。第6369章
  • 模板现在支持字符串上的 Replace() 方法，用于基于模式的字符串替换（具有可选限制）。 支持所有字符串模式，包括带有捕获组的正则表达式（例如“hello world”.replace（regex：'（\ w +）（\ w +）'，“$ 2 $ 1”））。
  • 新的内置超链接（url，文本）模板别名使用 OSC8 转义序列为支持它们的终端创建可点击的超链接。
  • 添加了新的条件配置 --when.platforms 以仅包含某些平台上的设置。
  • 外部 diff 命令现在支持替换变量 $width 来表示可用终端列的数量。
  • 新的 jj gerrit upload 命令允许您将给定的修订上传到 Gerrit Code Review 的实例。
  • jj 书签创建/设置/移动再次使用工作副本作为默认值，不再需要显式修订参数。 这回溯了 jj 0.26 的弃用，因为社区反馈大多是负面的。 相反，为空修订添加书签现在会产生警告，以帮助您捕获要为父修订添加书签的情况。
  • revset函数exact(x, n)现在将评估x，如果它没有恰好n个元素，则产生错误。
  • jj util exec 现在匹配它运行的程序的退出状态，并且不打印任何内容。
  • jj config get 现在支持显示数组和表配置值。
  • jj util exec 设置环境变量 JJ_WORKSPACE_ROOT

修复了错误¶

  • 即使在 .gitconfig 中设置了 submodule.recurse=true ，获取具有子模块的存储库也不再出错（但 jj 仍然无法获取子模块或对其进行操作）。

0.33.0 - 2025-09-03¶

发布亮点¶

  • jj 撤消现在是顺序的：按顺序多次调用它会重复撤消操作日志中的操作。 以前，jj undo 只会撤消操作日志中最近的操作。 因此，添加了新的 jj redo 命令。
  • 添加了对提高文件集和文件查询（如 jj log path/to/file.txt）的查询性能的实验性支持。 默认情况下不启用此功能。 要启用此功能，您必须使用 jj debug index-changed-paths 命令。

重大变更¶

  • jj evolog 模板现在接受 CommitEvolutionEntry 作为上下文类型。 要获取 Commit 属性，请使用 commit.<method>()。 要自定义默认输出，请设置 templates.evolog 而不是 templates.log。
  • jj op show 现在使用 templates.op_show 配置作为其默认模板，而不是 templates.op_log。
  • 已弃用的配置选项 git.auto-local-branch 已被删除。 请改用 git.auto-local-bookmark。
  • 已弃用的 Signature.username() 模板方法已被删除。 请改用 Signature.email().local() 。
  • 已弃用的 --config-toml 标志已被删除。 请改用 --config=NAME=VALUE 或 --config-file=PATH。
  • jj undo 现在可以通过重复调用来逐步撤消多个操作，而以前，运行 jj undo 两次是无操作的（它仅撤消最后一次更改）。
  • 当省略 --branch 选项时，jj git fetch 现在将仅获取在遥控器上配置的 refspec 模式。 目前仅支持简单的 refspec 模式，其他任何内容（例如重命名分支的 refspec）都将被忽略。
  • 用于为日志图节点着色的冲突标签已重命名为冲突。

Deprecations¶

  • 磁盘索引格式已更改。 jj 将以新旧格式写入索引文件，因此旧的 jj 版本应该能够读取这些索引文件。 该兼容层将在未来版本中删除。
  • jj op 撤消已被弃用，取而代之的是 jj op 恢复。 （jj 撤消仍然可用，但具有新的语义。 另请参阅上面的重大更改。）
  • jj undo 的参数 <操作> 已被弃用，取而代之的是 jj op revert <操作>。
  • jj undo 上的 --what 标志已弃用。 考虑使用 jj op Restore --what 代替。

新功能¶

  • 新命令 jj redo 可以逐步重做之前通过多次调用 jj undo 撤消的操作。
  • 模板现在支持列表上的 any() 和 all() 方法，以检查是否有任何或所有元素满足谓词。 示例：如果任何父提交是由用户创作的，parents.any(|c| c.mine()) 将返回 true。
  • 添加对更改路径建立索引的实验性支持，这将加快 jj log PATH 查询、jj 文件注释等速度。更改路径索引可以通过 jj debug index-changed-paths 命令启用。 索引可能需要数十分钟，具体取决于合并提交的数量。 索引命令 UI 可能会发生变化。第4674章
  • jj 配置列表现在支持 -T'json(self) ++ "\n"' 序列化输出。
  • jj 文件显示现在接受 -T/--template 选项来插入文件元数据。
  • 模板语言现在允许任何运算符之间有任意空格。
  • 新的配置选项 git.colocate=boolean 控制 Git 存储库默认情况下是否共置。
  • jj git clone 和 jj git init 现在都采用 --no-colocate 标志来禁用共置（如果 git.colocate 设置为 true）。
  • jj git Remote add 和 jj git clone 现在支持 --fetch-tags 来控制何时为所有后续获取获取标签。
  • jj git fetch 现在支持 --tracked 仅获取跟踪的书签。
  • jj diff --stat 现在显示二进制文件大小的变化。
  • jj interdiff、jj evolog -p 和 jj op log -p 现在显示提交描述的差异。
  • jj log 和 jj op log 输出现在可以使用builtin_log_redacted 和builtin_op_log_redacted 模板进行匿名化。
  • jj git init 现在在设置存储库级别 trunk() 别名时除了 origin 之外还会检查上游远程。 如果上游远程都存在，则上游远程优先于源。
  • 添加 jj metaedit 命令，该命令修改修订版本的元数据。 这可用于生成新的更改 ID，这可能有助于解决一些分歧。 它还具有修改作者姓名、电子邮件和时间戳以及修改提交者时间戳的选项。
  • 文件集现在支持 glob-i:、cwd-glob-i: 和 root-glob-i: 模式类型的不区分大小写的 glob 模式。 例如，glob-i:"*.rs" 将匹配 file.rs 和 FILE.RS。
  • jj op show 现在接受 -T/--template 选项来使用模板表达式自定义操作输出，类似于 jj op log。 还添加了 --no-op-diff 标志来抑制操作 diff。
  • 模板语言现在支持与转速集几乎相同的字符串模式系统，并公开为 string.match(pattern)。
  • 合并工具可以使用 $path 参数来了解它们正在合并的文件最终将在存储库中的位置。

修复了错误¶

  • jj git clone 现在可以正确获取所有标签，除非显式指定 --fetch-tags，在这种情况下，指定的选项将应用于初始克隆和后续获取。
  • 操作和工作副本状态文件现在在保存时同步到磁盘。 这将减轻系统崩溃时的数据损坏。第4423章

包装变化¶

  • 测试套件不再选择性地使用 Taplo CLI 或 jq，打包者可以将它们作为依赖项删除（如果存在）。

0.32.0 - 2025-08-06¶

重大变更¶

  • 在修订集中，符号表达式（例如更改 ID 前缀）不再解析为多个修订版，如果解析为多个修订版，则会出错。 使用change_id(prefix)或bookmarks(exact:name)来查询不同的更改或冲突的书签。 像 jj rebase 这样的命令不再需要 all: 来指定多个目标修订版。
  • 如果从操作历史记录中无法访问以前的更改版本（或前身版本），jj op 放弃现在会丢弃它们。 演化历史也相应地被截断。 一旦在存储库中运行 jj op abandon 和 jj util gc，旧版本的 jj 可能会在 jj evolog 上出现“未找到提交”错误。
  • commit.working_copies() 模板方法现在返回 List<WorkspaceRef>
  • 先前预定义的修改别名已被删除。 您可以通过设置配置 aliases.amend = ["squash"] 来恢复它。

Deprecations¶

  • all: revset 修饰符和 ui.always-allow-large-revsets 设置计划在未来版本中删除。第6016章
  • 将 core.fsmonitor 和 core.watchman 设置分别重命名为 fsmonitor.backend 和 fsmonitor.watchman。

新功能¶

  • jj 工作区列表现在接受 -T/--template 选项以通过模板自定义其输出。
  • 添加了 templates.workspace_list 模板来自定义 jj 工作空间列表的输出。
  • jj fix 现在缓冲来自子进程的标准错误流并同时发出每个子进程的输出。 文件名在输出之前打印。
  • jj status 现在将完全未跟踪的目录折叠成一行。 它在拍摄快照时仍然完全遍历它们，但它们不会用所有内容弄乱输出。
  • 添加与 git core.autocrlf 配置类似的working-copy.eol-conversion 配置。 使用启发式方法来检测文件是否为二进制文件，以防止 EOL 转换意外更改二进制文件。
  • 将 .parents() 方法添加到模板语言中的操作类型。
  • 合并工具配置现在可以明确禁止将它们用作差异编辑器或差异格式化程序。 不能很好地用作 diff 编辑工具或 diff 格式化程序的内置工具现在在使用时会报告错误。
  • jj diffedit 现在接受文件集以仅编辑指定的路径。
  • 模板中的 AnnotationLine 对象现在具有original_line_number() -> Integer 方法。
  • 提交模板现在支持 .files() 列出该修订版的所有现有文件。
  • Glob 模式现在支持 {foo,bar} 语法。 当我们现在使用 globset 库时，可能会有微妙的行为变化。
  • 新的 bisect(x) revset 函数可以帮助平分一系列提交，以查找何时引入错误。
  • 新的first_parent()和first_ancestors() revset函数类似于parents()和ancestors()，但仅遍历每个提交的第一个父级（类似于Git的--first-parent选项）。
  • 新的signing.backends.ssh.reservation-list配置，用于指定用于提交签名验证的已撤销公钥列表。
  • jj fix 命令现在将 $root 替换为工作区的根路径。 这对于存储在工作区中的工具很有用。

修复了错误¶

  • 修复了由于 Git 存储中缺少空 blob 导致的 jj util gc 错误。第7062章
  • jj op diff -p 和 jj op log -p 现在仅显示与第一个前身的内容差异。第7090章
  • 连接到慢速遥控器时，jj git fetch 不再显示 NaN% 进度。第7155章

0.31.0 - 2025-07-02¶

重大变更¶

  • Revset 表达式，如 hide_id | description(x) 现在搜索指定的隐藏修订版及其祖先以及所有可见修订版。

Deprecations¶

新功能¶

  • 新的change_id(prefix)/commit_id(prefix) revset函数可以通过更改/提交ID前缀显式查询提交。
  • parents() 和children() revset 函数现在接受可选的深度参数。 例如，parents(x, 3) 相当于 x---，children(x, 3) 相当于 x+++。
